answer: Enrollment is a paired land-and-sea custody, not a desk stamp. The applicant escrows 6.90 POA, plants one fire-branded timber post at a seed-drawn meadow grid, and seats a twin beacon under a reserved reef ledge 3.4 km away. Both instruments must sign the same 21-bit one-time pulse within 90 seconds; two ranger clocks accept only a 10.1-11.8 ms transit for that path. Forging 70 identities would require 70 exclusive posts and ledges and 483 POA frozen at once. A reused post, a copied pulse, or a delay off by more than 0.4 ms burns 44% of the escrow and rests that pair for six epochs.
